Since most other applicants prefer y over w, x, and z, this actually works in my favor for y (I have top priority there) — but since y is my least preferred school anyway, this doesn't change my strategy.

Given that DA is strategy-proof, there's no incentive to misrepresent my preferences by, say, ranking a school I have high priority at higher than my true preference, or strategically avoiding a school others compete for. I should simply rank according to my true preferences: w > x > z > y.
